2609.01936.title: Sparse Readout Prism: Explaining Logit-Lens Scores in Features Instead of Tokens
2609.01936.paper_summary: A language model's prediction of its next token develops across layers, and lens methods track this process by decoding intermediate hidden states into tokens. But a lens reading reflects both the hidden state and the readout (the unembedding matrix) used to decode it. Many lenses are fit on a corpus, and we show that two lenses differing only in their fitting corpus can report different tokens for the same hidden states. We call this dependence corpus conditionality. To examine readout structure independently of the fitting corpus, we introduce Sparse Readout Prism (SRP), which decomposes the readout using only its weights and expresses any token logit or logit difference as a sum of contributions from sparse readout features. This reveals readout features as a new unit of analysis for lens readings, exposing structure that token identities can obscure and enabling comparisons across tokens, contexts, layers, and lenses. Replacing the original readout with SRP's sparse approximation reconstructs 8.9-17.3 percentage points more of the tested logit differences than the strongest of six baselines built on geometric relations among readout rows. Ablating features shifts logit differences in proportion to their SRP contributions. Although token readings vary with the fitting corpus, the dominant readout feature remains stable. Because SRP uses no corpus in its construction, it provides a control independent of the fitting corpus for lens analyses.
2609.01936.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型對其下一個標記的預測在各層中發展，而透鏡方法通過將中間隱藏狀態解碼為標記來跟踪這一過程。<lb/>但透鏡讀取反映了隱藏狀態和用於解碼的讀出（去嵌入矩陣）。<lb/>許多透鏡是基於一個語料庫進行擬合的，我們展示了僅在擬合語料庫上有所不同的兩個透鏡可以對相同的隱藏狀態報告不同的標記。<lb/>我們稱這種依賴為語料條件性。<lb/>為了獨立於擬合語料庫檢查讀出結構，我們引入了稀疏讀出棱鏡（SRP），它僅使用權重分解讀出，並將任何標記的邏輯或邏輯差異表示為來自稀疏讀出特徵的貢獻之和。<lb/>這揭示了讀出特徵作為透鏡讀取的新分析單元，暴露出標記身份可能掩蓋的結構，並使得在標記、上下文、層和透鏡之間進行比較成為可能。<lb/>用SRP的稀疏近似替換原始讀出比基於讀出行之間幾何關係的六個基準中最強的基準重建了8.9-17.3個百分點的測試邏輯差異。<lb/>去除特徵會根據其SRP貢獻改變邏輯差異。<lb/>儘管標記讀取隨擬合語料庫而變化，但主導的讀出特徵保持穩定。<lb/>由於SRP在其構建中不使用任何語料庫，它為透鏡分析提供了一個獨立於擬合語料庫的控制。
